tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (Atria Dawn Preview), as it offers the broadest perspective on agentic AI in real research settings and provides empirical insights into human-AI collaboration that contextualize Paper 2's more theoretical self-improvement work. Papers 1 and 2 are tightly connected—both tackle recursive self-improvement of AI agents but from complementary angles (human-in-the-loop collaboration vs. autonomous policy optimization via dreaming). Paper 3 (PhysBrain 1.5) is more specialized and orthogonal, best read afterward if you have interest in embodied AI.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读论文1（Atria Dawn Preview），它在真实研究场景中提供了关于智能体AI最全面的视角，并给出了能帮助理解论文2自我改进工作的实证性人机协作分析。论文1和论文2紧密相关——两者都研究AI智能体的递归自我改进，但角度互补（人机协作 vs. 通过"梦境"机制实现的自主策略优化）。论文3（PhysBrain 1.5）较为专精且方向不同，若你对具身AI感兴趣，可放在之后阅读。
